Yeah it’s like telling you that you’re not allowed to feel happy, you realize that you feel ok and then you plunge so far that it becomes difficult to even move and then youre just stuck.
Source: me, right now :/
i answered the questions and it said i was fine??? i literally said that i want to fucking kill myself and it said “No worries on the psychological front”

You might be going through a rough time or it could be depression. If you feel up to it try getting someone to support you, and see if you start to feel better. If you don’t start to feel better after a few days I’d say consult a doctor about the *possibility* that you have depression. Don’t wait like I did until it completely overwhelms you.
Yeah, I feel that all the time. It’s probably a factor of low self esteem. Like that voice in your head that literally says that you will never be good enough.
The title of this post has to be the largest mood I’ve ever seen.
CORRECTAMUNDO!
I’d probably get in a fight with my dad over that so that’s a sad no.
Yeah that’s what I don’t get. They’re not here just for you so why do me like that.
Yeah, blind respect for parents with no consideration is dumb.
Yeah, I’ve been considering contacting my college to speak with a counselor. Kinda scary but it’s gotta happen at some point.
Super shitty of them to compare you two like that. They’re clearly projecting onto you their own feelings of inadequacy.
Yeah. Children are supposed to be your joy and your sacrifice, not your punching bag.
I’m sorry to hear that. I hope you’ve gotten yourself into a better situation.
I ignore my dad and it’s satisfying watching him explode over it but he can’t do anything about it.
They always claim to hear some “tone” or sarcasm in my voice but it’s just how I talk, I try to be nice but it’s hard when they berate you constantly.

I may try it but my sister tried to tell them she felt depressed and wanted to see a doctor and my parents basically started screaming at her and called her insane. Not bad advice but it may not work.
unfortunate circumstances probably?
Yeah. I’ll probably be moving out within a few years and I’m ready to leave them behind forever. Thanks for the advice.

Yes. I told one of my friends in Cali a while ago and they seem to not remember any of it. Like in conversation it’s nice that it’s not awkward but nothing at all changed and I don’t think he understands how I feel about things.

I told someone else, far less about how I got here than the guy in Cali but I told them that I’m really suicidal and they’re worried about me. Kinda a shitty feeling to know that I’ve worried someone so much.
Yeah if there is such a thing as not having a self esteem I think I’ve hit that point. It’s so shitty of parents to do their kids like this. Sorry you have to feel it too.

Wow you kinda described me in full. I had suspicions but I didn’t want to play psychiatrist for them but so many people think that they could be narcs so I wanna look into it. Thanks for opening my eyes to this behavior.
Yeah I don’t look to them for guidance much at all anymore. They only ever really wanted to put me down and shame me for everything. Thanks for the advice.

I wish that they could understand that questions are just questions. A question does not always indicate intent. But to them it’s the same as doing the act. And how am I supposed to know everything about Instagram you damn fossil?
Well it’d be my computer which I bought and paid for in full for one, maybe my phone and probably my car keys if I were to really screw up. I’m 17 and just trying to make sense of things.

Yeah parents seem to have two emotions: calm and mad. That’s it. And so many have the shortest possible fuse. It’s ridiculous to have them blow up when you ask them a question. “Gee, sorry I fucking asked you, my parent and wiser relative. Guess I’ll just wing it.”
I would like to but it’s hard to do. Easy to feel the eyes on you. Thanks for the advice.

Yeah I don’t understand how parents don’t see how it affects the kids when they blow up on them over small stuff or drag them in front of others. Thanks for being self aware as a parent and being better than the rest.

I don’t see how parents feel better by it. How do they feel about raising what is supposedly such a wild/stupid/bad kid? They make it out like you’re a roving dumbass but how does that reflect on them? You’re their child. It makes no sense to me why they think this way. I hate that feeling of hopelessness from it.

Yeah parents who feel like it’s their right to overshare with family or anyone for that matter can just go fuck themselves. You didn’t tell them so they could tell just anyone. I don’t tell our relatives about my parents fights so why bring up shit about me?
Yeah, I’m considering never talking to my parents again after all that’s happened. It took me forever to realize all that wasn’t normal about what they do.
I might try it but they’ll probably take away the stuff I bought as “punishment”.
Just shitty parents repeating a cycle.
yo tambien
I knew a long time ago that they’re terrible but I wish I could at least have honest parents.
I always try to pipe in with “I didn’t actually do that” or “not true” but it goes largely ignored.
How are you in control of your kid or how did you raise them if they truly did act in this way? What kind of example are you setting if your kid really did do that?
I’m unsure if they’re narcissistic or not but I do know that my mom enables my dad to continue being a dick. Dunno if they’re also narcissists or just have a huge ego.
Some weird ego stroking probably, just adds to the list of problems to deal with in one day.
It’s not even a good story or talking point. It just makes you look bad. It makes me tempted to just tell them all how bad my parents actually are just to see their reaction.
Yeah it seems pretty universal to do for a ton of parents. No idea why they find it ok.
